limitations: This is a static structural audit of the built-in seed catalog.
It does not verify the legal accuracy or completeness of citations.
It does not compare seeds with rule definitions in a live database.
It does not verify runtime enforcement mode or deployed behavior.

rules.title: Receiving: TLC Source Reference Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Request the traceability lot code source reference (GLN or business name) from your immediate supplier

rules.title: Receiving: Immediate Previous Source Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the business name and location of the entity that shipped this food to you

rules.title: Receiving: Reference Document Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the reference document type and number (e.g., BOL #12345, Invoice #INV-2026-001)

rules.title: Receiving: Receive Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date the food was received at your facility

rules.title: Shipping: Ship-From Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the ship-from location (GLN preferred, or location description)

rules.title: Shipping: Ship-To Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the ship-to location (GLN preferred, or location description)

rules.title: Shipping: Ship Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date the food was shipped

rules.title: Shipping: Reference Document Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the reference document type and number (BOL, invoice, or PO)

rules.title: Harvesting: Harvest Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date of harvest

rules.title: Harvesting: Farm Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the farm location description where food was harvested

rules.title: Initial Packing: Packing Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date of initial packing

rules.title: Transformation: Transformation Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date of transformation

rules.title: Cooling: Cooling Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date of cooling

rules.title: Cooling: Cooling Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the description or GLN of the location where the food was cooled

rules.title: Cooling: Temperature Reading Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the temperature achieved during cooling in °F or °C

rules.title: Cooling: Temperature Within Cold-Chain Window
rules.remediation_suggestion: Verify whether the reading is in °C or °F, correct the unit if needed, and document the deviation/corrective action when the reading is truly outside the operator's accepted range.

rules.title: Initial Packing: Packing Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the description or GLN of the initial-packing location

rules.title: Initial Packing: Harvest Location Reference Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the harvest location reference (GLN, farm name, or field identifier) this lot came from

rules.title: First Land-Based Receiving: Entry Point Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the port or land-based entry point where the food was received

rules.title: First Land-Based Receiving: Source Vessel / Origin Required
rules.citation_reference: Operational source-vessel identification (supports 21 CFR §1.1335(d) harvest provenance)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the source vessel name (for marine catch) or upstream origin reference for the incoming lot

rules.title: TLC Must Be Present
rules.citation_reference: Operational lot linkage (supports 21 CFR §1.1320; harvesting and cooling precede TLC assignment)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Assign a traceability lot code to this event

rules.title: Product Description Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the commodity and variety of the food (e.g., 'Romaine Lettuce, Whole Head')

rules.title: Quantity and Unit of Measure Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the quantity and unit of measure for this event

rules.title: Location Identifier Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Provide at least one location identifier: GLN (preferred) or location description

rules.title: GLN Format Validation
rules.remediation_suggestion: Verify the GLN is exactly 13 digits with a valid GS1 check digit

rules.title: Shipping: TLC Source Reference Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the GLN or business name of the entity that assigned the traceability lot code

rules.title: Transformation: Input TLCs Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: List all input traceability lot codes that were combined or transformed into this new lot

rules.title: Reference Document Required for All CTEs
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record at least one reference document: bill of lading, invoice, purchase order, or production record

rules.title: First Land-Based Receiving: Landing Date Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the date the seafood was landed (date vessel arrived at port)

rules.title: Harvesting: Commodity and Variety Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the commodity and variety of the food harvested (e.g., 'Romaine Lettuce')

rules.title: Receiving: Receiving Location Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the location description where food was received (GLN preferred)

rules.title: Initial Packing: Harvester Business Name Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the harvester's business name and phone number

rules.title: Initial Packing: Harvester Phone Required
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record the harvester's phone number

rules.title: Temporal Order: CTE Chronology Must Be Causal
rules.citation_reference: Operational integrity control (supports 21 CFR §§1.1325–1.1350 date KDE accuracy)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Verify event timestamps — a later-stage CTE cannot occur before an earlier-stage CTE for the same traceability lot code

rules.title: Identity Consistency: Product Must Not Change for Same TLC
rules.citation_reference: Operational product identity consistency (supports 21 CFR §1.1320 lot linkage)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Verify the product description matches across all events for this traceability lot code. If the product was legitimately transformed, use a transformation event

rules.title: Mass Balance: Output Cannot Exceed Input for Same TLC
rules.citation_reference: Operational integrity control (supports 21 CFR §1.1350(a)(1) quantity linkage)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Verify quantities — you cannot ship more than was received/harvested for the same traceability lot code. Check for data entry errors or missing input events

rules.title: FTL Classification: Product Must Be Classified
rules.citation_reference: Operational FTL classification (supports 21 CFR §1.1300 scope determination)
rules.remediation_suggestion: Record ftl_covered (true/false) or the product's FTL category on every CTE so the compliance stamp only applies where required
